_doc: PART 8 (16 Nov): per-lesson override of the 20 dB limiter-depth cap of the true-peak loudness path (scripts/media/tp-decide.mjs). Drive file ids only. cap_db must be > 20 and <= 21. The measured standard is unchanged (I -18 +-0.5 LUFS, TP <= -1.5 dBTP); a file that misses it never uploads. Listed: the 2 c001 lessons of failed-review.csv that needed 20.15 and 20.82 dB. per_id (PART 11c, 18 Nov): one id with its own cap, > 20 and <= 21.5 dB (182P… c001 needed 21.38 dB at 21).
